summary: Today's Hermes sessions were user-assistance focused. A PDF resume was reviewed and feedback provided to the user (Mohammad Hussain), covering formatting, content, and positioning improvements. A follow-up session explored AI agent capabilities around job application automation, specifically whether Hermes could autonomously apply to jobs on LinkedIn on behalf of the user.
highlights: Reviewed a user-submitted PDF resume and provided structured feedback on formatting, content clarity, and positioning
Discussed the scope and limitations of AI-assisted job application automation (LinkedIn/job boards)
Explored what autonomous job application workflows could look like with Hermes as an agent
Process-tape daily logger cron ran for the first time, establishing the logs/ directory structure
